instruction: A candid outdoor photograph, eye-level medium shot. In a grassy park with a large suspension bridge and trees in the background, the woman with a shaved head in a pink long-sleeve top and gray shorts (R1) and the bearded man in a white t-shirt and black leggings (R2) sit side-by-side on the grass. The woman (R1) sits cross-legged on the left with her hands resting on her knees, while the bearded man (R2) sits cross-legged on the right with his hands resting in his lap. Both have their eyes closed in peaceful meditation. Bright, natural daylight illuminates the scene with soft shadows.
